title: Aria implements all TAnIA v6 concepts, enterprise-ready + any-device-optimized
outcome_criterion: Every one of the 12 TAnIA v6 concept groups is represented and demo-usable in the Aria platform (admin/admin demo), the app runs well on low-end/mobile devices, passes typecheck + the test suite, preserves the existing Mantu design language, and reads as an enterprise product not an AI demo.
success_verifier: npm run typecheck && npm test green; Playwright demo walkthrough exercises chatbox->handoff, star/source badges, funnel board, #Vivier, prequal/interview, agent architecture; mobile nav reaches all routes; 3D floor runs with instanced proxies.
out_of_scope: Changing the visual design language / palette / layout system
Real external integrations (SMART ATS, Knight M, OneStart, My Referral, Dust Chrome ext) beyond honest mock adapters
Normalizing the JSONB workspace blob into relational tables
Redis-backed distributed rate limiting (no infra in demo)
assumptions: Aria = Mantu's instance of TAnIA (persona name in app title).
Careers chatbox is client-side to stay demo-usable and avoid new public attack surface.
TAnIA layer is additive over the existing outbound-sourcing model; base types stay authoritative.

premortem.risk: Public chatbox widens attack surface (CV upload SSRF/malware/cost)
premortem.mitigation: Client-side only: deterministic scoring, mock CV parse, no server endpoint, writes to store.

premortem.risk: 3D floor white-screens low-end GPUs (300 full robots)
premortem.mitigation: InstancedMesh proxy tier + frameloop=demand + geometry singletons + device quality tier.

premortem.risk: Adding TAnIA layer drifts triplicated stage-rank/metrics
premortem.mitigation: Single canonical mapping in tania.ts; derive, don't duplicate.

premortem.risk: New surfaces introduce a second inconsistent look
premortem.mitigation: Reuse existing tokens/primitives (Card/Badge/glass); no new palette.
Wave-based execution, verify each wave, stop when all 12 concepts demo-usable + audits pass.
